scope: East Japan store research for11published jewelry products; no catalog or UI changes.
method: Read public official maker/shop pages and transport-operator visitor information. Store descriptions and access are original summaries. No form submission,contact,order,GoogleMaps scrape,logo/photo/map copying or embedding.
stockPolicy: A published physical shop is not proof that the exact featured SKU is in stock. Do not label a production studio,municipal organizer address or old event as a current retail outlet.

name.ja: 浜松屋 本店・見える工場

address.ja: 〒250-0314 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町畑宿138

closedDays.en: Open year-round, as listed by the maker

access.ja: 箱根湯本駅4番乗り場から、畑宿方面・旧街道経由の路線Kで「本陣跡」へ。公式案内の所要目安は約15分です。
access.en: The maker directs visitors from Hakone-Yumoto bus stand 4 to Honjin-ato on routeK toward Hatajuku or Motohakone via the old road; its stated ride estimate is about 15 minutes.

visitSummary.ja: 箱根・畑宿にある工房直営の本店。寄木細工を見ながら、気になる耳飾りやペンダントの現物を探す訪問先です。
visitSummary.en: The maker’s main shop in Hatajuku, Hakone, with a visible workshop. A place to explore its marquetry collection in person.

parking.ja: 公式案内に約10台の駐車場表記あり。
parking.en: The maker lists parking for about 10 cars.

stockNote.ja: 紹介商品の店頭在庫・現在の柄は未確認です。訪問前に公式サイトで営業情報と取扱いを確認してください。
stockNote.en: The featured SKU, current patterns and store stock are not confirmed. Check the maker’s latest shop information and availability before visiting.

address.ja: 〒250-0521 神奈川県足柄下郡箱根町箱根17番地

hours.en: 10:00–16:00, listed in the official guide and Hakone Navi

closedDays.ja: 年末年始・不定休あり（箱根ナビ掲載）。訪問前に公式の最新情報をご確認ください。
closedDays.en: Year-end/NewYear and occasional closures are listed by Hakone Navi; check the retailer’s latest information.

access.ja: 箱根登山バス「箱根関所跡」から徒歩約1分。
access.en: About1 minute on foot from the Hakone-Sekisho-ato bus stop, as listed by Hakone Navi.

visitSummary.ja: 箱根関所通りの寄木細工専門店。オンラインで紹介している丸山の耳飾りについて、現地の取扱いを確認する際の店舗です。
visitSummary.en: A marquetry specialist on Hakone Sekisho Street. Use its official shop information to check the in-person selection of the earrings listed online.

parking.ja: 店舗前の一般車・マイクロバス駐車の公式案内あり。大型バスは近隣の恩賜箱根公園駐車場案内。
parking.en: The retailer publishes parking guidance for cars/minibuses and directs large coaches to the nearby Onshi-Hakone Park car park.

stockNote.ja: C/Dのピアス・イヤリングの店頭在庫や柄は未確認です。
stockNote.en: Physical stock and patterns of the C/D pierced and clip-on pairs have not been confirmed.

access.en: The shop is in Hirai 5-chome. Use the official location and Google Maps for a route; no station travel-time estimate is asserted here.

visitSummary.ja: 切子の製造・販売・体験を行う凛然の店舗。切子グラスやアクセサリーのコレクションを紹介しています。
visitSummary.en: RINZEN’s published maker shop, connected with its kiriko making, sales and classes. The maker also produces glass accessories.

parking.ja: 専用駐車場なし。公式案内は近隣コインパーキングの利用を案内。
parking.en: No dedicated parking; the official guide suggests nearby paid parking.

stockNote.ja: 「星華」「葉の雫」の店頭在庫は未確認です。来店前に公式の営業情報と商品取扱いを確認してください。
stockNote.en: Store stock of Seika and Leaf dewdrop is unconfirmed. Check the maker’s latest opening information and product availability before visiting.

Nearest stop Honjin-ato. Official access describes Hakone-Yumoto bus stand4, Hatajuku or Motohakone-ko via old road, routeK, about15min. About10 parking spaces. Individual accessory SKU stock and retail-visit reservation rules are not stated.

sources.title: 東京ガラス工房 凛然 — 凛然について

The official navigation links https://www.rin-zenshop.com/ as its online shop, but this research could not read its product content reliably; retain BECOS individual product links for the verified SKUs.

Hamamatsuya secondary brochures may list another Hatajuku address or hours; use current maker guide Hatajuku138 and09:00–17:30,not older secondary collateral.

RINZEN official news list contains older notices; the current shop page lists10:00–19:00/Monday. Before-visiting confirmation is necessary; this research does not independently certify a business is operating at this instant.
